title: Resolve channel diagnostic E-220
summary: Identify and correct an open 4–20 mA loop reported as E-220 on Northstar version 3.2.

sections.title: Diagnosis
paragraphs: E-220 is raised when measured loop current remains below 3.6 mA for the configured debounce interval.
steps: Confirm the displayed channel and timestamp.
Place dependent control logic in a documented safe state.
Measure loop power at the transmitter.
Restore the loop and verify good quality after the debounce interval.
